name: Mia Gobble
headline: Producer & Generalist Game Developer
about: I am a game developer specializing in Roblox development but aspiring to go off-platform! I'm always looking for opportunities to work with those willing to take risks and try new things. My philosophy with game development is to create new ideas for new games. I look up to studios who share a similar philosophy, rather than making safe sequels that contribute to an already oversaturated game market.

experience.title: Talent Manager & Lead Developer
experience.description: I now handle talent management at Tencell Studios in addition to my development work. Some of my new responsibilities include talent outreach, interview processing, skillset evaluation, and more.

experience.title: Producer & CEO
experience.description: Oxomo Games is a brand new studio created by me, aiming to take risks with game design and discover new audiences on Roblox. My time here is spent producing and generalizing, ensuring we get high-quality games released. We're excited to soon release Velocity and Deep Depths. This studio is my opportunity to try design ideas and workflows before I apply a similar philosophy to my main line of work.

experience.title: Producer & Lead Developer
experience.description: I used to work on Slap Battles! I took on a variety of roles, including project management, data analysis, game design, generalist development, and scrum leadership. During my time, I helped the game reach a peak of 149k concurrent users. Under my leadership, I directly increased engagement, retention, and revenue, all while keeping the community satisfied.

experience.title: Generalist Developer
experience.description: Prior to being a producer and lead developer, I was a generalist development contractor, working on critical reworks to Slap Battles.

experience.title: Narrative Deputy Lead
experience.description: I was a narrative lead for the community gamejam project for ASGC. It was my job to work between the department leads and contributors to create a complete and interesting narrative design, mostly as a reviewer to narrative writing.

experience.title: Research Panelist
experience.description: I was a part of Meta's AR/VR User Research Panel. During my time there, I actively tested new AR/VR products geared towards developers of the Horizon Worlds platform, leaving critical feedback about workflows and design decisions.

experience.title: Producer & CEO
experience.description: Iconic Gaming is a studio I founded that focused on pushing creative online games on the Roblox platform. As of April 2025, I handed off the CEO position to pursue new opportunities. During my time, I created back-to-back projects that succeeded, often peaking at 2kâ€“12k CCU. I handled production, lead development, hiring management, and more.

experience.title: Event Organizer
experience.description: I previously created developer-oriented educational events on the Roblox platform. These events aimed to be engaging, memorable, and valuable for new developers getting started.

experience.title: Accelerator Program Member
experience.description: Iconic Gaming was funded and guided by the Roforco Accelerator program as a part of YCombinator 22. The funded project was Disaster Masters, a one-against-all disaster genre twist on Roblox.

experience.title: Game Developer
experience.description: Responsible for front-end gameplay programming and plugin tools development. Most notably worked on Crocs World, a branded experience for the Crocs shoe company.

experience.title: Software Engineer
experience.description: Worked on Super Hero Tycoon and another unreleased project, recoding core systems and reworking visuals using a proprietary framework.

experience.title: Contract Programmer
experience.description: Built a parkour system for Combat Warriors on Roblox, including ledge climbing, pole swinging, and more.

experience.title: Programmer
experience.description: Worked on an upcoming FPS on Roblox. Responsible for an additive animation system and rigid body physics system.
